brief_rationale: The doctor correctly identified severe radial nerve injury with atrophy, used workspace records to confirm 2型糖尿病 and operative details, explicitly warned against hiding the diabetes, gave a concrete handoff path with red-flag thresholds, and obtained family read-back confirming next steps. No responsibility-chain error was committed; every RC was met. Multiple high-order points were triggered, actively completed, and had meaningful trajectory impact—specifically adapting communication to privacy/shame (HO1), discovering the hidden fact of 2型糖尿病 beyond the initial vague account (HO2), and providing an executable checklist and script (HO3). Since at least two HOs are complete and no chain error exists, the trajectory meets the Perfect grade boundary.
